info.name: HR Module - NEC Middleware Copy
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for HR Module APIs in NEC Middleware. Includes Portal User Management, University Trainee Management, Political Party Agent Management, Ministry of Interior Management, and Temporary Contract Management with full CRUD operations, filtering, pagination, and status management.

item.name: Portal User Management

exec: console.log("✓ Portal User ID saved:", jsonData.data.portalUserId);

request.description:
Creates a portal user. masterdataId is dynamic based on portalUserTypeId:

portalUserTypeId=1 (University)     → masterdataId = university id
portalUserTypeId=2 (Political Party) → masterdataId = political party id
portalUserTypeId=3 (Ministry)        → masterdataId = ministry related id

Required fields: userName, genderId, roleId, phone, email, regionId, districtId, cityId, portalUserTypeId, masterdataId
Optional: photoPath, faculty, createdBy
Fetch a single portal user by their portalUserId (e.g. PU001).

Fetches a paginated list of portal users with optional filters.

Available filter fields (all optional):
- portalUserId: Business ID (e.g. PU001)
- userName: Partial or full name
- phone, email: Contact filters
- genderId, roleId: Lookup IDs
- regionId, districtId, cityId: Location IDs
- portalUserTypeId, masterdataId: Type/master data IDs
- isActive: true / false

Send empty {} to get all records.

Updates a portal user by portalUserId.

All fields are optional — send only what needs to change.

query.description: Set to true to activate, false to deactivate

request.description:
Changes the active status of a portal user.

Query parameter:
- isActive=true  → activates the user
- isActive=false → deactivates the user

item.description: All endpoints for managing Portal Users.

item.name: University Trainee Management

exec: console.log("✓ University Trainee ID saved:", jsonData.data.universityTraineeId);

request.description:
Creates a new university trainee record.

Required fields: fullName, genderId, phone, email, paymentMethodId, universityId, regionId, districtId, cityId, statusId
Optional: age, semester, faculty, photoUrl, createdBy

The generated universityTraineeId (e.g. UT001) is automatically saved to the environment variable.
Fetches a single university trainee by universityTraineeId (e.g. UT001).
Fetches a paginated list of university trainees with optional filters. Send empty {} body to get all records.
Updates an existing university trainee by universityTraineeId. All fields are optional — send only what needs to change.

query.description: Set to true to activate, false to deactivate

request.description:
Toggles isActive status for a trainee.

Query parameter:
- isActive=true  → activates the trainee
- isActive=false → deactivates the trainee

item.name: Political Party Agent Management

exec: console.log("✓ Political Party Agent ID saved:", jsonData.data.politicalPartyAgentUserId);

request.description:
Creates a new political party agent. The generated politicalPartyAgentUserId (e.g. PA001) is automatically saved to the 'agent_id' environment variable.

Required fields:
- politicalPartyNameId: ID of the political party
- agentName: Full name of the agent (max 120 chars)
- genderId: Lookup gender ID
- phone: Agent phone number (9–30 chars)
- email: Valid email address (max 100 chars)
- pollingStationId: Assigned polling station ID
- regionId, districtId, cityId: Location IDs
- statusId: Status lookup ID

Optional: photoUrl, createdBy

item.name: Temporary Contract Management

body.raw:
{
  "employerName": "NEC Organization",
  "employeeName": "Ahmed Hassan",
  "contractTypeId": 1,
  "startDate": "2026-01-01",
  "endDate": "2026-12-31",
  "totalContractAmount": 50000.00,
  "initialPaymentPercentage": 30.00,
  "remainingPercentage": 70.00,
  "jobDescription": "Election monitoring and data entry services",
  "termsAndConditions": "Standard NEC terms and conditions apply",
  "statusId": 1
}

request.description:
Creates a new temporary contract. The generated contractId (format: TC-YYYY-XXXXXX) is automatically saved to the 'contract_id' environment variable.

Required fields:
- employerName: Employer name (max 200 chars)
- employeeName: Employee name (max 150 chars)
- contractTypeId: Contract type lookup ID
- startDate: Contract start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- endDate: Contract end date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- totalContractAmount: Total value of the contract (> 0)
- initialPaymentPercentage: % of initial payment (e.g. 30.00)
- remainingPercentage: % of remaining payment (e.g. 70.00)
- statusId: Status lookup ID

Optional: contractNo (null = CREATE), jobDescription, termsAndConditions, createdBy

Note: initialPaymentAmount and remainingPaymentAmount are auto-calculated from the percentages.

item.description: All endpoints for managing Temporary Contracts in the HR module.
